verses.text_en: And after that my grandfather Enoch gave me the teaching of all the secrets in the book and in the Parables which had been given to him; and he put them together for me in the words of the book of the Parables.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga moj djed Henok predao mi je pouku o svim tajnama iz knjige i Prispodoba koje su bile dane njemu; za mene ih je sastavio u riječima Knjige prispodoba.

verses.text_en: And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and =makes me to tremble= because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’
verses.text_hr: Toga dana Mihael odgovori Rafaelu: „Moć duha odnosi me i =čini da dršćem= zbog strogosti suda nad tajnama, suda nad anđelima. Tko može podnijeti strogi sud koji je izvršen i pred kojim se oni tope?“

verses.text_en: And Michael answered again, and said to Raphael: ‘Who is he whose heart is not softened concerning it, and whose reins are not troubled by this word of judgement (that) has gone forth upon them because of those who have thus led them out?’
verses.text_hr: Mihael ponovno odgovori Rafaelu: „Čije srce zbog toga ne bi omekšalo i čija se utroba ne bi uznemirila zbog ove riječi suda koja je izišla protiv njih radi onih koji su ih tako izveli?“

verses.text_en: And it came to pass when he stood before the Lord of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of the Lord; for the Lord of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Kad je stao pred Gospodara duhova, Mihael je rekao Rafaelu: „Neću stati na njihovu stranu pred očima Gospodnjim, jer se Gospodar duhova razgnjevio na njih zato što se ponašaju kao da su Gospodin.

verses.text_en: Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’
verses.text_hr: Zato će sve što je skriveno dolaziti na njih u vijeke vjekova. Ni anđeo ni čovjek neće imati udjela u tome; samo su oni primili svoj sud u vijeke vjekova.“
